subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Should WebChat support hiding the floating new-message catch-up indicator, and what alternate scroll-to-latest affordance must remain when auto-scroll is off?
rationale: The indicator is intentionally both an unseen-content signal and the manual recovery path, so hiding it requires a UX policy choice rather than a mechanical code decision.

options.title: Add safe indicator modes
options.body: Persist visible, dismissible, and hidden modes while retaining a separate accessible scroll-to-latest control.

options.title: Restyle only
options.body: Reduce obstruction through placement and styling without adding a preference or removing the recovery action.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Retain the floating control as mandatory because it is the established unseen-message recovery affordance.

recommendation.title: Add safe indicator modes
recommendation.body: Persist visible, dismissible, and hidden modes while retaining a separate accessible scroll-to-latest control.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the current auto-scroll settings surface and explicitly separated this indicator decision in the issue discussion.
